#432 · Tiger Cat Pokémon

Purugly

Normal

Sinnoh · Generation 4

Purugly is a Normal-type Tiger Cat Pokémon first found in Sinnoh (Generation 4). It stands 1 m tall and weighs 43.8 kg. It evolves from Glameow. Its highest base stat is Speed (112), with a base stat total of 452.
